note: City of Worthington campground in Olson Park, on Sunset Bay of Lake Okabena, with a boat landing, the trail around the lake and a dog park. Sites 1-12 are the ones along the bay. --Claude
summary: City page (browser) + city site map: 63 electric spurs + 5 tent sites (64-68); $30 electric, $35 bay sites 1-12, $23 non-electric is the tent sites -> nightly_low 23 -> 30; weekly $200 / monthly $700; season Apr 1-Oct 31 confirmed manual; water only at central taps (water false); showers/laundry/dump/wifi; Campspot booking link. Lakefront kept (sites 7-12 ~10 m of open grass and the lake bike trail from Sunset Bay's NW arm). Pin OK.
flags: Fees base 23 -> 30: the city's only non-electric sites are the five tent sites ('Five camping sites are designated for tenting'; map: '5 TENT SITES' 64-68), so the $23 'non-electric' rate (Campspot's 'Primitive Campsite') is a tent rate; the cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome uses is a $30 electric spur. Campspot could not be re-queried (0 sites available on 2027-05-04; the season is not loaded), so whether Campspot offers the primitive type to a 23-ft motorhome is unverified. Revert to 23 if it does.

Waterfront: keep lakefront, on sites 7-12. City map: spurs 1-12 run east from the loop road to the bike trail on the Sunset Bay shore; the city prices 'sites 1-12 along the bay' at $35. Esri z19 at 43.6092,-95.6342: RVs on the northern spurs (about 43.6096,-95.6346 to 43.6090,-95.6341) stand at the paved lake trail with ~5-10 m of open grass beyond it to the water. The water there is Sunset Bay's narrow arm (~20 m wide) between the park and the South Shore Drive causeway, not open lake; sites 1-6 to the south face the open bay but sit under shore trees. On-water rests on the lone-path precedent (8303, 13623). If the public trail is read as a use, 7-12 drop to lakeview.
Pin 43.60750,-95.63580 sits on the campground's south loop (sites ~55-63), inside the campground: OK.
